test_clip_basic: test the DataFrame.clip method with scalar lower and upper bounds
test_clip_inplace: test the DataFrame.clip method with inplace=True modifies the frame in place
test_clip_series_bounds: test the DataFrame.clip method with Series objects as lower and upper bounds along axis 0

test_clip_frame_bounds: test the DataFrame.clip method with DataFrame objects as lower and upper bounds
